name: AgentRail
description: A local control plane for AI coding agents - provides routing, supervising, and auditing multi-agent work across repos and CI. Helps teams track which agent is doing what and which changes are ready for review.

name: Prave
description: The missing management layer for AI Agent Skills - enables authoring once and deploying skills across Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Cline, and Amp with telemetry and audit. Includes MCP integration for Claude Desktop.

name: Polygram
description: AI-native design and coding app to build mobile & web apps - combines planning, design, code generation, live preview, and GitHub sync in one workflow.

name: Pixcode
description: A self-hosted control room for AI coding agents - enables orchestration and controlled execution of agents across development workflows.

name: Cplt
description: macOS Seatbelt sandbox wrapper for AI coding agents - runs agents inside Apple's kernel-level sandbox to prevent unauthorized access to credentials, secrets, and sensitive files.
